camera_visual_review.scope: Human-visible inspection by assistant of first, middle contact, last RGB in all three views: object/hole and hand present, no blank frames. All199 RGB-D frames passed numeric content, clock and pose checks. Single-lane only.

reviewed_preaction_failure.reason: Orchestration chose expert-only speed wrapper for position student; assertion before first physics step. Preserve and skip; no repeat of this cell.

decision.rationale: Precision improvement reviewed separately; otherwise measured validation plateau, fitted train motion and weak unseen motion justify one bounded data contrast, not proof of data insufficiency

selected.scope: Exploratory 3-family paired screen, not a population reliability estimate

candidates.scope: Exploratory 3-family paired screen, not a population reliability estimate

speed_decision.policy: One stable alpha per episode, continuous uniform between tested endpoints

motion_diagnosis.scope: Teacher-forced observed trajectories, deterministic per-anchor noise; contact phases are proxies, not stable-grasp labels

items.reason: Completed original disposable one-update save/restore smoke; formal best/last and receipt preserved; no recovery/model comparison dependency

cleanup.protected: All400+200 formal data, expert/assets, best/last, comparison caches and failure evidence retained

data_diagnosis.phase_scope: Mutually exclusive diagnostic proxies: contact force >0.1N, object rise>3cm, native alignment/subgoals; not stable-grasp truth

sampling.explanation: Each episode equally likely; an anchor in the longest receives fewer selections than one in the shortest. No sampler change.

observed_motion_summary.scope: Median per-trajectory requested-target metrics, unmatched full trajectories with different outcomes/durations. Student boundary jumps and excessive target motion are observed; not a causal claim about physical joint speed or expert pacing.

camera_acceptance.scope: All RGB/depth pixels, all pre-action frames. Projection checks field of view, not occlusion; preview requires visual review.

audit.scope: whole card, time-weighted batch and complete 60-second means; current process lifetime; other jobs untouched
